Y, E, Q, S, U, H, L, K, F, X, V, P, T, O, G, Z (letters placed on the figure)
main_text.p: Est igitur triangulum y x b, qualitate simile triangulo n f o: sed non æquale. Deinde triangulum y v a, simile est triangulo q e n: itemq; triangulum v z d, simile est triangulo l q h: deniq; triangulū z x c, simile est qualitate triangulo p σ g. Rursus coniuncto quadrangulo n o p q, inscribantur puncta s t k l, eodem situ quo interiecta sunt puncta n o p q, in quadrangulo y x z v. Cōnectantur etiam illa puncta s t k l. Erunt hæc quoq; æqualia triangula.

page.notes: The diagram is a figure of nested squares and diamonds with labelled corner letters; its letters are given above only as placed. The Greek-like sigma in "p σ g" is printed as such and is doubtful. Show-through text from the reverse side in the margins was omitted.
